execution_dependency: P0-A must be DYNAMIC_PARTIAL_OVERLAP_REPRESENTATION_SENSITIVITY_SUPPORTED and this run must bind the exact P0-A raw SHA. P0-B is not required because P0-C tests problem consequence, not SQC feasibility.
purpose: Test whether the same representation-induced source-mixture change that shifts qualified semantic task distributions also changes the expected correctness/difficulty of those tasks for a frozen author-style Qwen3 solver, using independent reference tool-call truth and no arm-specific solver evaluation.
claim_boundary: P0-C is one-step curriculum consequence evidence only. It does not establish end-of-evolution training utility, cumulative regret, or SQC method superiority and cannot by itself unlock the full C4 claim.

solver.system_prompt: Use each parsed generated sample's own system field or author default_solver_system_prompt, exactly as question_evaluate.evaluate._chat_from_item with skill_mode=False.
solver.bounded_deviation: Only n is reduced 9->3 to keep the falsifier within <=1 GPU-hour. The reduction is frozen before P0-A outcomes and applies identically to every task/source/representation. Temperature/top-p/top-k/max_tokens remain author settings.

units.selection: Evaluate every P0-A contract-valid generated task; no outcome-based subsampling. P0-A already requires >=16 valid tasks per source.
units.truth: author summarize_tool_call_predictions against each parsed sample's frozen reference answer
units.per_task_metric: p_hat = fraction of the 3 solver samples containing a matching reference tool call
units.invalid_solver_output: counts as incorrect through the author grading function

counterfactual_reuse.observable: Expected p_hat under each frozen mixture, computed from the same source-conditioned task/solver results.

statistics.bootstrap_unit: contract-valid generated task resampled within source skill, preserving the frozen mixture weights
statistics.margin_provenance: P0-C is only a bounded coarse one-step consequence screen with n=3 per-task samples. The effect margin is fixed at 5 absolute percentage points before P0-A outcomes, matching the 0.05 meaningful dynamic-shift scale already preregistered for P0-A. This does NOT change the stricter 2pp heldout utility non-inferiority margin in the full confirmatory experiment.
statistics.per_merge_pass: Signed expected-p_hat delta relative to split has a 95% task-bootstrap interval entirely above +0.05 or entirely below -0.05.

decision_rule.STRONG_GO: Both mandatory-overlap merges pass the per-merge solver-consequence criterion.
decision_rule.PARTIAL: Exactly one merge passes; report transformation-specific one-step consequence without generalizing to both witnesses.
decision_rule.STOP_ONE_STEP_UTILITY_CONSEQUENCE: Neither merge passes; representation changes semantic curriculum distribution but no >2pp verified frozen-solver consequence is established on this bank.
decision_rule.INVALID: P0-A not GO, raw SHA mismatch, qualification/provenance failure, solver runtime/hash mismatch, or GPU budget exceeded.

next_if_strong_go: Use as bounded one-step consequence evidence in the paper motivation/P0 section; C4 end-of-evolution remains locked to the full confirmatory design.
next_if_partial: Report only the passing transformation; do not average it into a broad C4 claim.
next_if_stop: Do not add solver samples, tune the 2pp margin, or switch backbone. Continue to full experiment only if P0-B/method rationale independently justifies it; do not cite P0-C as utility support.
